rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for being unwilling to do something.

example.english: I'm reluctant to move abroad for this job.
example.traditional: 我唔願意為咗份工搬去外國。
example.jyutping: ngo5 m4 jyun6 ji3 wai6 zo2 fan6 gung1 bun1 heoi3 ngoi6 gwok3

rows.note: Use this for milder reluctance when the person does not really want to do something but may still do it.

example.english: It's raining so heavily today, so I'm reluctant to go out.
example.traditional: 今日落咁大雨，我唔係好想出街。
example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 lok6 gam3 daai6 jyu5 ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 soeng2 ceot1 gaai1

rows.note: Use this for the hesitant side of reluctant when someone is wavering rather than firmly refusing.

example.english: With so many choices, I'm reluctant to decide right away.
example.traditional: 面對咁多選擇，我有啲猶豫應唔應該即刻決定。
example.jyutping: min6 deoi3 gam3 do1 syun2 zaak6 ngo5 jau5 di1 jau4 jyu6 jing1 m4 jing1 goi1 zik1 hak1 kyut3 ding6
